WITH date_range AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk, d_date
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_date BETWEEN CAST('2001-04-02' AS date) AND CAST('2001-06-01' AS date)
),
item_filtered AS (
    SELECT i_item_sk, i_item_id
    FROM item
    WHERE i_current_price BETWEEN 0.99 AND 1.49
),
sales_base AS (
    SELECT cs_order_number,
           cs_item_sk,
           cs_warehouse_sk,
           cs_sold_date_sk,
           cs_sales_price
    FROM catalog_sales
    WHERE cs_sold_date_sk IN (SELECT d_date_sk FROM date_range)
      AND cs_item_sk IN (SELECT i_item_sk FROM item_filtered)
),
returns_base AS (
    SELECT cr.cr_order_number,
           cr.cr_item_sk,
           cr.cr_refunded_cash
    FROM catalog_returns cr
    WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM sales_base sb
        WHERE sb.cs_order_number = cr.cr_order_number
          AND sb.cs_item_sk = cr.cr_item_sk
    )
),
sales_by_date AS (
    SELECT w.w_state,
           i.i_item_id,
           dr.d_date_sk,
           dr.d_date,
           SUM(sb.cs_sales_price - COALESCE(rb.cr_refunded_cash, 0)) AS net_sales
    FROM sales_base sb
    LEFT OUTER JOIN returns_base rb
        ON rb.cr_order_number = sb.cs_order_number
       AND rb.cr_item_sk = sb.cs_item_sk
    JOIN warehouse w
        ON sb.cs_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    JOIN item_filtered i
        ON sb.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN date_range dr
        ON sb.cs_sold_date_sk = dr.d_date_sk
    GROUP BY w.w_state, i.i_item_id, dr.d_date_sk, dr.d_date
)
SELECT w_state,
       i_item_id,
       SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(d_date AS date) < CAST('2001-05-02' AS date)
                THEN net_sales
                ELSE 0
           END) AS sales_before,
       SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(d_date AS date) >= CAST('2001-05-02' AS date)
                THEN net_sales
                ELSE 0
           END) AS sales_after
FROM sales_by_date
GROUP BY w_state, i_item_id
ORDER BY w_state, i_item_id
LIMIT 100
